task.title: Knapsack optimization and algorithmic verification
task.prompt: Create an educational 0/1 knapsack optimization notebook with at least 12 items, integer weights/values and a capacity. Implement and compare (1) a greedy value/weight heuristic and (2) an exact method using dynamic programming or exhaustive enumeration. Verify feasibility, explain why greedy can be suboptimal, show selected items and a plot of value/weight, and include a brute-force cross-check for a small instance. No commercial solver. Assert the exact solution is feasible and not worse than greedy. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, capacity, greedy_value, optimal_value, optimal_weight, item_count.
